recognize_zh: 脾臟低倍 Bcl-2 染色中，擴大的白髓結節與周圍紅髓的淋巴細胞大多陽性，結節外圍陽性較深，中央較淡而不均；未見整片陰性的反應性生發中心，支持腫瘤性 B 細胞（脾邊緣區淋巴瘤）表現 Bcl-2。
features: Low-power view of expanded, confluent white pulp nodules
Bcl-2 positivity in most lymphoid cells within nodules, with darker staining at the nodule periphery and paler, heterogeneous staining centrally
No sharply demarcated Bcl-2-negative reactive germinal centers
Positive lymphoid cells also infiltrating intervening red pulp/perivascular areas
describe_en: Bcl-2 immunohistochemical stain on spleen at low power shows expanded, partly confluent white pulp nodules in which the majority of lymphoid cells are Bcl-2 positive. Staining is stronger at the periphery of the nodules and paler and heterogeneous centrally, which may reflect colonized residual follicle centers. Positive cells also extend into the intervening red pulp. Because Bcl-2 is also expressed by normal T cells and mantle and marginal zone B cells, the stain supports but does not establish a neoplastic process; findings are compatible with splenic marginal zone lymphoma in context.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma shows Bcl-2 co-expressed with CD10 and BCL6 in the follicle centers, whereas SMZL is CD10 negative.
Reactive germinal centers are sharply Bcl-2 negative with a Bcl-2-positive mantle rim, and the white pulp is not diffusely expanded.
Mantle cell lymphoma is Bcl-2 positive but also CD5 and cyclin D1 positive.
